poolishPreparation.title: POOLISH PREPARATION
poolishPreparation.subtitle: First step: starter preparation
poolishPreparation.step2Description: In a large bowl, dissolve yeast in water and add honey
poolishPreparation.step3Description: Add flour and mix with a wooden spoon until you get a homogeneous mixture, then let rest {{ rtRestTime }} hour(s) at room temperature covered with plastic wrap, then {{ coldRestTime }} hour(s) in the refrigerator

doughPreparation.title: DOUGH PREPARATION
doughPreparation.subtitle: Second step: kneading and shaping
doughPreparation.step1Description: Take out the poolish 1 hour before use
doughPreparation.step2Description: Weigh the quantities to add to the poolish:
doughPreparation.step3Description: In the poolish bowl, add water and salt. Mix with spoon until water is absorbed
doughPreparation.step4Description: Add flour little by little and mix with spoon
doughPreparation.step5Description: When it's no longer possible to use a spoon, transfer the dough to the work surface
doughPreparation.step6Description: Work the dough by kneading it, the flour must be completely integrated
doughPreparation.step7Description: Make some folds with the dough and form a nice ball (soft and flexible)
doughPreparation.step8Description: Let rest 10-15 minutes under a bowl
doughPreparation.step9Description: Reform a nice ball and let rest another 1 hour in an airtight container
doughPreparation.step10Description: Put a thin layer of fine semolina on a plate
doughPreparation.step11Description: Retrieve the dough and with a dough cutter or spatula form dough balls (well stretched) of approximately
doughPreparation.step12Description: Place the dough balls on the plate leaving space between each one (they will still grow)
doughPreparation.step13Description: Close the plate or put plastic wrap over it and let rest between 1 and 3 hours
doughPreparation.tipsDescription: If the dough is too sticky, form a ball and let rest 10 minutes under a bowl
doughPreparation.successMessage: 🎉 And there you have it, they are ready to be transformed into PIZZA!

storage.title: STORAGE
storage.subtitle: Storage tips
storage.refrigerator: Refrigerator: Dough balls keep for 2-3 days
storage.freezer: Freezer: Freezes very well, don't keep more than 2-3 months
